To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) BN double-walled nanococoons and nanotubes can be mass-produced using an electric-arc discharge in a BN-containing gas mixture; (ii) the BN nanotubes are predominantly double-walled; (iii) the nanotubes form bundles; (iv) the nanococoons can be etched to form hollow nanococoons; and (v) the hollow nanococoon yield can be improved by adding a catalyst to the gas mixture.

1) We have developed an efficient, high-yield, and reliable method for the production of bulk amounts of BN nanotubes; 2) The method produces almost exclusively BN double-walled nanomaterials (nanotubes and nanoncocooons); and 3) The BN nanotubes and nanoconcoons self-assemble into bundles (ropes) and nanococoon clusters.

(1) we developed a new high-yetld synthesis method that produces bulk quantities of pure BN nanowires; (2) the method produces almost entirely double-walled nanowires that self-assemble into nanotube ropes; and (3) the synthesis method also produces pure BN `nanococos' by etching out the core of BN-coated crystallite particles.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis and properties of non-carbon nanotubes, including boron nitride (BN) nanotubes.
the development of new methods for the production of bulk quantities of non-carbon nanostructures, such as boron nitrides, silicon carbides, and boron carbides.
the synthesis of BN nanotubes by plasma-arc evaporation of boron and nitrogen targets.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the plasma-arc method can be used to mass-produce high-quality double-walled BN nanotubes and BN nanococoons.
we have developed a new method for the synthesis of BN double-walled nanococoons, nanotubes and their bundles in large quantities.
we have developed a new method to produce bulk amounts, in high yields, of BN double-walled nanococoons and nanotube ropes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated that the plasma-arc method can produce large amounts of high-purity BN nanotubes and BN nanococoons.
we have demonstrated a simple and reliable method of producing bulk quantities of BN nanotubes and their related nanomaterials.
we have developed a high-yield plasma arc method for mass production of BN double-walled nanococoons and ropes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the plasma-arc technique is a versatile method to produce bulk quantities of non-carbon nanotubes with a high degree of control over their size and morphology.
the plasma-arc method produces high-purity BN nanotubes and BN-coated particles with high yield, and that the method is easily adaptable to other materials.
the plasma-arc method can be easily scaled-up to produce large quantities of BN nanotube materials for a wide range of applications.
